description: This file configures USB Mass Storage Device (MSD) parameters and descriptors for a firmware project using ChibiOS. It defines device and configuration descriptors, string descriptors, endpoint configurations, and event handling for USB MSD functionality.

methods.name: get_descriptor
methods.description: Handles USB descriptor requests, returning device, configuration, or string descriptors based on request parameters.

methods.name: usb_event
methods.description: Handles USB driver events such as reset, configuration, suspend, wakeup, and stall.
